descriptions.cc39d_apply_records56_801dbc3c: Walk a zero-key-terminated array of 56-byte records: find each record's id among the registry's element pointers (element id +36) by linear search; on a miss call the create slot (+148) with the id and retry the same record, on a hit call the slot at +152 with the element and record and advance. Returns 0. 56-byte member of the 0x801dbd34 record-walk family; partial observed views, class names, slot roles and sizeof unknown.
